item.tib: ma mo gsang ba'i thugs sgrub thugs dam gnad nas bskul pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i ma mo srid rgyal dre'u nag gi thugs sgrubs kyi gnad bskul 'di ni zhu tshang gi g.yu 'brang phyug mo nas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs/ phyis su 'dra yul bla grwa yongs rdzogs kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas mkha' 'gro'i brda ris dag par phab cing yi ge pa ni g.yung drung dpal bzang pos bgyis pas/ bkra shis//
